intro: A curated look at the calibre of homes that define the North Shore. These are representative residences from across the Ray White North Shore network, a sense of the coastline, the craftsmanship and the lifestyle this market is known for.

items.blurb: Timeless character meets modern luxury on a 1,047sqm freehold title, with uninterrupted Rangitoto views from nearly every room.
An architectural mid-century reawakening, mezzanine living, a culinary kitchen and a poolside entertainer's retreat in a coveted cul-de-sac.
Coastal living dialled up, a sleek, low-maintenance home moments from Milford and Mairangi Bay beaches.
A near-new coastal sanctuary with soaring ceilings, multiple alfresco zones and a glimpse of the sea and Rangitoto Island.
